title: A directional zero–one law for finite-range-dependent random environments
exact_target: For nearest-neighbor random walk in a stationary ergodic uniformly elliptic environment on $Z^d$, $d\geq 3$, whose rows have the specified finite-dependence independence for separated infinite sets, is the annealed probability of $X_n\cdot \ell \to +infinity$ always zero or one for every deterministic nonzero real direction ell?
